reader.reads: Read all three German places, both languages of each thesis and the link against its grounds; compared all three places with the 1813 scan.

tragic-pleasure:shares-a-moral-ground-wi.note: Page 161 says that the feeling of moral purposiveness lies at the ground of ‘der tragischen Rührung und unserer Lust an dem Leiden’; page 154 calls the experience of the moral law a good in the particular sight of Hüon and Amanda. Neither place states the proposed common ground of tragic pleasure generally and pleasure in suffering: tragic emotion and tragic pleasure are not named as the same thing in these places.

summary: The three conceptions are borne by their places and the three places read as the packet on the scan. The proposed link goes beyond the places in treating tragic pleasure as sharing the stated ground of tragic emotion and pleasure in suffering.
